name: Real Money
overview: Reality TV series based on the home and tour life of Eddie Money and family in Southern California. Real Money is a reality TV series that followed the life of rock musician Eddie Money, his wife Laurie, and their five children (Zach, Joe, Jesse, Dez, and Julian) as they navigated daily life, family chaos, and touring. The show, which aired on AXS TV, offered a look into the family's home life in Southern California, highlighting humorous situations, family dynamics, and the challenges of blending a rock and roll lifestyle with raising a family.
